arabic text: Kufe ka aur shaam ka manzar
english translation text: The scenes of Kufa and Shaam

arabic text: Yaad jab aajata hai baba, dil mera phat\njaata hai baba,\nKufe ka aur shaam ka manzar
english translation text: Whenever I remember them, Baba, my heart\nbreaks apart, Baba:\nthe scenes of Kufa and Shaam

arabic text:
Kabr pe shabbir ki karte the abid bhuka,
Hogayi kya kya jafa, suniye shahe karbela,
Sar pe kisi ke na thi chadar
Yaad jab aajata hai baba, dil mera phat
jaata hai baba,
Kufe ka aur shaam ka manzar
english translation text:
At Shabbir's grave, Abid would weep aloud:
Listen, O King of Karbala, to all the cruelties committed;
not one lady had a veil upon her head.
Whenever I remember them, Baba, my heart
breaks apart, Baba:
the scenes of Kufa and Shaam

arabic text:
Ek rasan me bandhe chote baro ke gale,
Barsare darbar sab is tarha laaye gaye,
Kothe se barsaat the pathar,
dil mera phat jaata hai baba,
Yaad jab aajata hai baba, dil mera phat
jaata hai baba,
Kufe ka aur shaam ka manzar
english translation text:
The necks of young and old were tied within one rope,
and all were brought before the court in this condition;
stones rained down from the rooftops,
and my heart breaks apart, Baba.
Whenever I remember them, Baba, my heart
breaks apart, Baba:
the scenes of Kufa and Shaam

arabic text:
Kufe ke baazar me majma-e kafar me,
Ek tamasha sa tha, aale sitam gaar me,
Ayse me maa behne khule sar,
Yaad jab aajata hai baba, dil mera phat
jaata hai baba,
Kufe ka aur shaam ka manzar
english translation text:
In Kufa's marketplace, amid a crowd of unbelievers,
the family of the oppressed was displayed like a spectacle;
our mothers and sisters stood bareheaded.
Whenever I remember them, Baba, my heart
breaks apart, Baba:
the scenes of Kufa and Shaam

arabic text:
Tok se hargis na tha baba mera sar juka,
Hath kari aur beri ka koi muje gham na
tha,
Arey dekha nahi jata tha manzar,
Yaad jab aajata hai baba, dil mera phat
jaata hai baba,
Kufe ka aur shaam ka manzar
english translation text:
Baba, the heavy collar never
made me bow my head; the
handcuffs and chains caused me no grief.
But I could not bear to
look upon that scene. Whenever I remember
them, Baba, my heart breaks apart,
Baba: the scenes of Kufa and Shaam

arabic text:
Arey bali sakina ka gham dil ye nahi
bhul ta,
Sab ke the shaane bandhe uska bandha tha
galaa,
Arey dard se wo roti thi mustar,
Yaad jab aajata hai baba, dil mera phat
jaata hai baba,
Kufe ka aur shaam ka manzar
english translation text:
The grief of little Sakina is something this heart
can never forget;
everyone's shoulders were bound, but a rope encircled
her throat.
She cried in agony, utterly distressed.
Whenever I remember them, Baba, my heart
breaks apart, Baba:
the scenes of Kufa and Shaam

arabic text:
Maktalo tarikh ki kar na sake hak ada,
Likha ani se hazi girya-e abid kiya,
Arey kahte the ye abide muztar,
Yaad jab aajata hai baba, dil mera phat
jaata hai baba,
Kufe ka aur shaam ka manzar
english translation text:
Historians could never fulfil the right of recording the battlefield;
with tears for ink, they wrote of Abid's weeping.
This is what the distressed Abid would say:
Whenever I remember them, Baba, my heart
breaks apart, Baba:
the scenes of Kufa and Shaam
